title: The Plot Thickens

lesson.themeZh: 识别伪装、判断危险与及时求助
learningObjectivesZh: 梳理Zella从等待朋友到发现异常信息的推理过程
解释Festian如何伪装并将Zann一行带到Far Frontier
理解Panno提供的识别Festian线索，并概括结尾出现的新危机

sections.title: Waiting for the Visitors
sections.summaryZh: Zella发现Zann和Perda迟迟没有抵达。尽管Raff认为他们可能只是耽搁，Zella根据Zann一向会及时告知计划变化的习惯，开始担心他们遇到了麻烦。

sections.title: A Message from the Far Frontier
sections.summaryZh: 新的消息飞蛾带来意外消息：Zann一行被带到了Far Frontier。原本被认为是宫廷雇员的车夫其实可能是能变形的Festian；Zella推测对方利用漩涡和虫洞改变路线，并用魔法让众人睡着、控制飞龙。远疆附近没有虫洞，魔法又很弱，他们难以自行返回。

sections.title: A Strange Change in the Mayor
sections.summaryZh: Zella和Raff没能找到Loro，转而来到镇广场。镇长似乎不记得前一天在洞穴里发生的事，这让Zella怀疑眼前的镇长可能也是别人伪装的。

sections.title: The Three-Toed Clue
sections.titleZh: 三只脚趾的线索与新危机
sections.summaryZh: Panno补充了辨认Festian的重要线索：无论变成什么模样，它们都会保留只有三根脚趾的脚。Zella将这一线索与镇长的异常记忆联系起来，随后和Raff前往洞穴寻找Loro，却发现Loro的一条腿正被拉进虫洞，故事在新的危机处结束。

vocabulary.example: The visitors were delayed on their journey.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 访客们在旅途中耽搁了。

vocabulary.example: Zella made a glow ball to light the dark path.
vocabulary.exampleZh: Zella制造了一个发光球照亮黑暗的道路。

vocabulary.example: Even the slowest cloud gliders should have arrived.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 即使最慢的云端滑翔器也应该已经抵达。

vocabulary.example: A flare of hope made Zella catch the message moth quickly.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 希望突然涌现，Zella赶紧接住了消息飞蛾。

vocabulary.example: The coach may have traveled through a vortex.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 那辆龙车可能穿过了一个漩涡。

vocabulary.example: Zella felt overwhelmed by the dangerous situation.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 面对危险的局势，Zella感到不知所措。

vocabulary.example: Festians retain their own feet when they change shape.
vocabulary.exampleZh: Festian变换外形时仍会保留自己的脚。

vocabulary.example: The three toes can help people recognize a Festian.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 三根脚趾可以帮助人们认出Festian。

questions.question: Why did Zella become worried when Zann and Perda did not arrive?

options.text: She knew they had decided to stay in First City.
She believed Zann would have told them if the plan had changed.
She thought Raff had sent them to the wrong town.
She had heard that the town square was closed.

questions.explanation: Zella认为Zann如果改变行程，一定会提前告诉他们。正因为没有收到这样的消息，她才觉得这次迟到可能意味着出了意外。

questions.question: What did Zann's new message reveal about the person driving the dragon coach?

options.text: The driver was Loro in disguise.
The driver was a dragon who had escaped.
The driver was a Festian pretending to be a trusted palace employee.
The driver was Mayor Ruxton's relative.

questions.explanation: 消息称他们原以为车夫是可信任的宫廷雇员，后来却怀疑那其实是一个Festian，可能通过变形伪装成他们认识的人。

questions.question: How did Zella think the Festian got the dragon coach to the Far Frontier so quickly?

options.text: He made the dragons fly through a storm.
He asked another group of travelers to carry the coach.
He took the coach through a vortex and came out near the Far Frontier.
He used a map to find a shorter road across the mountains.

questions.explanation: Zella根据Zann的推测解释：Festian可能把整辆龙车带入漩涡，再从靠近Far Frontier的虫洞出来，最后继续飞行。

questions.question: What physical clue did Panno say could identify a Festian, even when it changed shape?

options.text: It always kept its own feet, which had three toes.
It always had silver eyes.
It could never speak like a human.
It always left glowing footprints.

questions.explanation: Panno指出Festian无论变成什么形态，都会保留自己的脚，而它们的脚只有三根脚趾，这是可靠的辨认方法。

questions.question: What danger does Zella discover at the very end of the episode?

options.text: Raff has disappeared into the town square.
The mayor has taken the message moth.
The dragon coach has returned without its riders.
Loro is being pulled into a wormhole.

questions.explanation: 结尾Zella听到身后的动静，转身发现Loro的一条腿正被拉进虫洞，故事以这一突发危险收尾。
